title: ETHcavenger
tagline: A DeFi scavenger hunt API for Ethereum for communities.
description:
In the Honduras Blockchain community we wanted to create a scavenger hunt that rewards anyone that completes it as a way to learn about DeFi and Tokens by playing. 

We created an API that searches for common tokens and sees if users have "caught them" if all are true we can reward the user.
how_its_made: This project uses Go and Heroku in order to create a rest  API. It also uses Go Ethereum and Infura in order to read the state of the blockchain and assign values to a user address as the current state of the scavenger hunt search.
